purpose: Teach: 反転/利潤/インフォメーション/呼称/ジレンマ/主たる/オファー/売上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文での反転構造を分析しろ
lines.en: Ren, analyze the inverted structure in the paper.
lines.style: Direct but not sharp. Measured pace. The tone of someone who expects clarity and precision. A slight lean forward — engaging, not dismissive. Authority that comes from knowing the work matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の利潤性を考えております
lines.en: Yes. I'm considering the research's broader implications.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful. Slight hesitation — choosing words precisely. Respectful but not obsequious. Quiet conviction underneath. The voice of someone who takes the task seriously and wants to get it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のインフォメーションを共有しろ
lines.en: Ren, share what you've found in the lab materials.
lines.style: Clear instruction. Steady rhythm. Not urgent, but expectant. The comfortable directness of someone used to being listened to. A hint of warmth — this is a teaching moment, not a test.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。専門用語の呼称統一を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on standardizing the terminology across our notes.
lines.style: Quiet diligence in the voice. Methodical, deliberate. No rushing. Slight self-correction mid-phrase — 'I'm working on' rather than 'I worked' — showing ongoing effort. Genuine investment in getting the details right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、若手研究者のジレンマも理解しろ
lines.en: Ren, you need to understand the position young researchers are in.
lines.style: Slightly softer than the previous directives. Less command, more guidance. A pause before 'understand' — giving weight to the point. The voice of someone who's seen this bind before and wants him to see it too.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。主たる研究テーマを明確にしました
lines.en: Yes. I've clarified what my main research focus is.
lines.style: Firmer than before. A small note of accomplishment in the voice — something concrete achieved. Still respectful, but less tentative. 'I've clarified' lands with quiet certainty. The pride of having made a decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外大学からオファーが来ることもある
lines.en: Ren, sometimes offers come from overseas universities.
lines.style: Measured, almost reflective. Not casual — weighty information being offered. A slight slowdown on 'sometimes' — acknowledging both the rarity and the possibility. The voice of someone sharing hard-won experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の売上げ的効果も考えます
lines.en: Yes. I'm also thinking about what research success might look like in practical terms.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a touch uncertain. Softer opening. A slight trailing-off at the end — leaving room for more learning. The voice of someone grappling with competing pressures but staying grounded. Quieter than before — something personal in this one.
